Container.Name: mica-slicer
Container.Overview: Mica Slicer, a native 3D-printing slicer, streamed to your browser (Mica at https://[IP]:3001, the read-only web dashboard with printer status, cameras and the library at http://[IP]:3002). Host networking lets Mica find printers that announce themselves. Keep it on your own network or behind Tailscale.

Config.Name: Settings
Config.Description: Mica's settings, profiles, printers (and their secrets file) and the library index.

Config.Name: Models
Config.Description: Your models and projects; Mica's file dialogs and library see them under /prints.

Config.Name: GPU
Config.Description: An Intel or AMD GPU for rendering (remove it to render in software).

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: User that owns the files in the mapped folders (Unraid: nobody = 99).

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: Group of the files in the mapped folders (Unraid: users = 100).

Config.Name: Dashboard: allow printing
Config.Description: 1 lets the dashboard take G-code uploads and send or start prints. Empty: read-only.

Config.Name: Dashboard: extra host names
Config.Description: Full DNS names the dashboard may be opened with besides IP addresses, short names and .local (e.g. a Tailscale name).

Config.Name: Login user
Config.Description: Optional login for the streamed Mica (not the dashboard).
